title: Label Smoothing in Disguise? Gated Knowledge Distillation for Low-Resource Bangla Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.01065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gated knowledge distillation (KD) weights teacher signals per token or example, aiming to trust an imperfect teacher only where it seems reliable. We test two gates: EWAD (entropy-weighted agreement-aware distillation), which gates tokens by teacher confidence, and CHAD (counterfactual harm-aware distillation), which gates examples by gradient alignment with validation data. Across six Bangla-centric tasks, three student models (60M to about 2B parameters), and two teacher families, no gate significantly improves plain KD in 45 comparisons. KD also fails to beat cross-entropy (CE) fine-tuning on gold outputs in 40 single-seed comparisons or three-seed runs on four tasks; CE leads on every summarisation metric. The main benefit of KD is regularisation: over ten fixed epochs, CE students lose 0.030 to 0.044 token-F1 from their early-stopped checkpoint, versus 0.005 to 0.025 for distilled students. translated_title: 变相的标签平滑？面向低资源孟加拉语文本生成的门控知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: 门控知识蒸馏（KD）通过对每个token或每个样本的教师信号进行加权，旨在仅在教师模型看起来可靠之处信任不完美的教师。我们测试了两种门控机制：EWAD（熵加权一致性感知蒸馏），通过教师置信度对token进行门控；以及CHAD（反事实危害感知蒸馏），通过与验证数据的梯度一致性对样本进行门控。在六项以孟加拉语为中心的任务、三个学生模型（从6000万到约20亿参数）以及两个教师模型家族的实验中，45次对比中没有任何门控机制显著优于普通KD。在40次单种子对比或四项任务的三种子运行中，KD也无法在黄金输出上击败交叉熵（CE）微调；且CE在所有摘要指标上均领先。KD的主要益处是正则化：在十个固定epoch中，CE学生模型相比其早停检查点损失了0.030至0.044的token-F1，而蒸馏学生模型仅损失0.005至0.025。无需教师的标签平滑弥补了大部分（差距）。
tldr: 该研究在低资源孟加拉语文本生成任务上系统评估了两种门控知识蒸馏方法，发现它们均未显著优于普通知识蒸馏或交叉熵微调，KD的主要作用仅是正则化，而无需教师的标签平滑即可获得类似效果。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates two gated knowledge distillation methods on low-resource Bangla generation, finding that neither significantly improves over plain KD or cross-entropy fine-tuning—KD's main benefit is regularization, which teacher-free label smoothing largely replicates.
